items: Calcium carbonate and calcium hydroxide are added to acidic soils to raise the pH (neutralise acidity), making the soil better for crops.
Calcium and magnesium are essential plant nutrients: calcium is needed for cell-wall development, and magnesium is the central atom of chlorophyll, vital for photosynthesis.
Compounds such as calcium nitrate and magnesium sulphate (Epsom salts) can be used as fertilisers.
